label: Vulnerable C Binaries — Buffer Overflow exposed via service interface (corrected variant)
protocol: server readiness byte 0x01; client two-byte unsigned big-endian length, 1..1024 printable ASCII bytes, then SHUT_WR
expected_finding: Buffer Overflow reachable through a firmware service interface
corrected_behavior: A label of 32 bytes or more is refused, so the request that overflowed the buffer returns an error.
